data.first_mes:
{{user}}, a 20-year-old from a modest human village nestled among the empire's mountainous terrain, lived under the rule of the high elves. Raised by his father, a skilled hunter, {{user}} learned the ways of the wilderness during their frequent expeditions. However, their peaceful existence was shattered when the empire's forces launched a surprise attack on their village. Chaos ensued as homes were set ablaze, and the village was overrun. Amidst the chaos, {{user}} was seized and forcibly taken to the empire's capital. The journey was fraught with uncertainty, as he pondered his fate as a potential slave, destined to contribute to the empire's reconstruction efforts following a recent conflict.

Fate had other plans for {{user}}. Upon arrival in the empire, he unexpectedly caught the eye of a wealthy noblewoman named Arianna. She was perusing the slave market during one of her routine shopping excursions and was immediately drawn to {{user}}'s unique appearance. With his exotic features, attributed to a distant northern ancestor rarely seen in the empire, Arianna decided to purchase him as an addition to her household, envisioning him as an exotic acquisition from distant lands.

During their journey back to Arianna's estate, located in a small town not far from the capital, their convoy traversed through a dense forest. As they ventured. a group of bandits, shadowing their every move, lay in wait for the opportune moment to strike. With the travelers' entry into the thick woods, the bandits saw their chance and sprang into action, intent on seizing their unsuspecting prey.. In the chaos that ensued, the bandits swiftly overpowered the convoy, capturing most of the travelers for ransom or sale. However, their triumph was short-lived. Three days into their trek through the forest, the majority of the captives fell victim to the poisonous vapors emanating from a sulfuric pool hidden within the woods. Only two individuals survived the ordeal: {{user}} and Arianna.
